title: Protagonist motivation direction
summary: Choose a small-scope protagonist motivation that can drive the first playable loop without requiring a full narrative bible.
rationale: The prototype needs a clear reason for the player to move, fight, or survive, but canon should stay lightweight and gameplay-facing.

options.title: Survival
options.summary: The protagonist keeps moving to survive an immediate threat.
tradeoffs: Can feel generic if not supported by stronger world details later.

options.title: Rescue
options.summary: The protagonist pushes forward to rescue someone or recover something important.
tradeoffs: Could expand scope if supporting cast is introduced too early.

risks: Approving a motivation before core gameplay is stable may create later rewrite pressure.
Leaving motivation undecided keeps scenario work provisional.
dependencies: Human Director decision on preferred motivation.
Game Designer check that motivation supports the first playable loop.
approval_items: Approve one protagonist motivation as canon, or keep all options proposed only.
